title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・もっと、もっと

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky wins the autumn Tenno Sho. She receives praise from her friends and promises Special Week they'll compete again at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, after the race, Seiun Sky discovers she's injured one of her legs. Fortunately, it's not serious, but her doctor recommends she rest for the remainder of the year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In a rare sight, Seiun Sky emotionally pleads that I let her run in the Arima Kinen. After all the hard work she's done to break past her personal wall, she can't hide how she truly feels about winning.
